verdict.rationale: Earth Class Mail documents its own check-deposit service: checks are mailed directly to your bank of deposit so you get paid without handling the paper. This is a paid add-on. The mechanism is physical forwarding to the bank, not the provider depositing the check itself, and the docs say nothing about endorsement or reconciliation. Missing for 10: evidence that the provider endorses checks, any reconciliation or deposit-status reporting, details of the deposit workflow and timing, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
